The '''Wilds Laboratory''' was a small research outpost in the [[Lower Wilds]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] such as [[Renning]] conducted experiments there.
